comment: The welcome window opened in the first launch's state, which the boot refuses under a capture run, so the door builds it as the boot does. It opens on Quick settings with the Language row first. English (United States) is picked from that row and the window's words read American, then English (United Kingdom) and they read British again. The window is put away and opened a second time with no state, which is MainDialogs' own window as a later launch has it, on Recent.
